libraries.name: jsonfox
libraries.description: JSON parser and serializer for VFP in a single PRG

libraries.name: linqvfp
libraries.description: LINQ-style queries over collections and cursors for VFP 9: Where, Select, OrderBy, GroupBy, Join and aggregates

libraries.name: foxcollection
libraries.description: Data structures for VFP 9: array, dictionary, stack and queue, with Count and Item() like a Collection

libraries.name: foxextends
libraries.description: Functions VFP 9 never had: PRINTF, NEWGUID, ENUM, regular expressions, ADIR and AFIELDS as objects, and a password box

libraries.name: foxremote
libraries.description: One API for SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Firebird and SQLite from VFP 9 through ODBC: parameters, transactions, buffered cursors that save their changes, and DBF migration

libraries.name: foxstylesheet
libraries.description: Style sheets for VFP 9 forms: CSS-like themes by class, name and event, 16 built-in themes, and light and dark with a sun and moon switch

libraries.name: vfpstretch
libraries.description: Resizes every control of a VFP 9 form with its window, and opens forms at a zoom shared by the whole application

libraries.name: getdirpro
libraries.description: A folder picker for VFP 9 written in VFP: GETDIR() with a tree that opens at once, typed paths, new folders and the theme of your application

libraries.name: foxdock-editor
libraries.description: Small utilities for the code editor: a new GUID on the clipboard or at the cursor

libraries.name: foxdock-history
libraries.description: Keeps the previous version of each form, class library, report, label and menu you edit, with diff and restore

libraries.name: foxdock-foxforge
libraries.description: Hosts FoxForge, the VFP project workshop, in the FoxDock menu

libraries.name: foxdock-themes
libraries.description: Color themes for the IDE: syntax colors, the editor font, and the font and colors of the main window

libraries.name: foxdock-designer
libraries.description: Tools for the Form Designer and the Class Designer: inspect the selection, copy it as code, and find the control under the mouse

libraries.name: foxdock-queries
libraries.description: A window for the .sql files of FoxQuery: list them, check them for each engine, run them and compile them into a catalog

libraries.name: foxdock-data
libraries.description: Tables, cursors and database connections from the IDE: JSON in and out, export, SQL scripts and an explorer for ODBC servers
